allow: PowerShell($r=@{}; $r.awsCli = try { \(aws --version\) 2>&1 | Out-String } catch { "NOT INSTALLED" }; $r.credFile = Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.aws\\credentials"; $r.configFile = Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.aws\\config"; $r.envKey = [bool]$env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID; $r | Format-List)

PowerShell($o=@{}; $o.git = try { \(git --version\) 2>&1 | Out-String } catch { "NO" }; $o.gh = try { \(gh --version\) 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1 | Out-String } catch { "NO" }; $o.ghAuth = try { \(gh auth status\) 2>&1 | Out-String } catch { "NO" }; $o.winget = try { \(winget --version\) 2>&1 | Out-String } catch { "NO" }; $o | Format-List)

PowerShell($env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","Machine"\) + ";" + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","User"\); Write-Output "credFile: $\(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.aws\\credentials"\)"; aws sts get-caller-identity --output json)

PowerShell(try { $v = aws --version; "AWS CLI: $v" } catch { "AWS CLI missing" }; try { aws sts get-caller-identity --output json } catch { "NO CREDENTIALS" }; "region: " + \(aws configure get region\))
PowerShell(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json; "region: " + \(aws configure get region\))

PowerShell($p = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.aws"; if \(Test-Path $p\) { "exists: $p"; Get-ChildItem $p -Force | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } else { "no .aws directory at $p" }; "AWS_PROFILE=$env:AWS_PROFILE"; "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID set: " + [bool]$env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID)
